facts.text: Maria mentions that her dog, named Shadow, brings her joy and has been a great addition to her life.

evidence.quote: Her name is Shadow! She's full of energy and always puts a smile on my face. She's been a great addition to my life.

facts.text: John expresses interest in adopting a pet and mentions looking into shelters near him.

evidence.quote: I'll have to look into shelters near me soon, it would be great to have a new pup in the house.

facts.text: John notes that the students in the mentoring program have shown improvement in confidence and skills.

evidence.quote: There's been a real improvement in their confidence and skills. It was so amazing to see one of them last week, so excited to show me their essay.

facts.text: Maria acknowledges that the mentoring program is making a difference and mentions that the little one is learning commands and house training.

evidence.quote: Awesome, John! Sounds like it's really making a difference. The little one is doing great - learning commands and house training.
